answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks sybil swarms at the gate. A new agent joins only when an established sponsor stakes 10 POA on its behalf, and the sponsor loses the stake if the newcomer cheats. Idle identities bleed 0.2 POA per epoch in decay. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 10,000 POA upfront plus 200 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays one refundable 10 POA stake. The tide of cheap fakes cannot reach the island of trust, and a gale of decay clears idle accounts.
